creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`tai run claude -- --resume` works, but `tai run claude -- --model x` fails with "Too many positional arguments. Unused: [x]", and `tai run claude --help` (a documented example) prints tai's own help instead of passing `--help` to the target. The `args` positional in `cmd/tai/main.go` probably needs to be variadic in Ra, with everything after the target (or after `--`) passed through verbatim. Until then `run` is close to unusable with arguments.

Separately, `tai run <target> --config ...` is now refused with an explanation, because `--config` is tai's global config-repo flag (codex has a `--config` of its own). Once pass-through works, check that `tai run codex -- --config k=v` reaches codex.

Found while adding --config / TAI_CONFIG; predates that work (same on v0.2.0).
title: tai run passes only one argument through to the target
